about: Decision 271 validation set (24 Oct 2026). Each case is one enabling hit, re-parsed from best-collection-xml.zip by check-271-enabling-role.ts, labelled BY HAND from its enacting words: power = the words name this target as the power exercised. Cases 1-80 are a seeded random draw (40 classified power, 20 mention, 20 unstated by the first version) from a 1,777-stride sample the rules were NOT tuned on; K1-K10 are the CRaG s.20 test case and the regressions found while building. A case is found by gid + target + back + (tail = last characters of the enacting words before the anchor | refs). H1-H50 are a SECOND holdout (seeded draw over a 2,311-stride sample: 20 power, 8 back-reference, 12 mention, 10 unstated), labelled by hand with the rules FROZEN: the classifier then scored 47/50 - two false powers (H18, H25) and one power not seen (H48). The rules were changed for those three AFTER that score was taken, and the cases are kept here as regressions. A case with mayBeAbsent counts as not-power when the parser no longer writes the hit at all. T1-T30 are a THIRD holdout (1,501-stride; 12 power, 6 back-reference, 7 mention, 5 unstated), labelled with the rules frozen after the H fixes: it scored 27/30, all three misses FALSE POWERS (T3, T5, T18), fixed afterwards by the inheritance rule and the longer-phrase tie-break. Two earlier labels were changed after a run and each case says so: 29 and 16. F1-F40 are the FINAL holdout (997-stride; 16 power, 6 back-reference, 10 mention, 8 unstated), labelled with the rules frozen after the T fixes and reported as THE measured figure: 39/40, no false power, one power not seen (F35), fixed afterwards.
